name: alex-act-core
description: The self-activating Alex ACT baseline runtime plugin. Installs 35 reusable framework skills and 9 slash-command prompts covering instruction activation, project bootstrap, a curated read-in-place skill bridge, epistemic discipline, continuity semantics, security and privacy, tooling awareness, project-capability authoring, and engineering craft. Core owns its 16 runtime instructions, receipt, project-local scaffold, and bridge doctor. Native Copilot CLI owns plugin lifecycle; native host memory and repository files provide continuity; Document Tools owns conversion.
